uutiset.t: Trump’s AI Gambit Fuels Wild Thanksgiving Week on Wall Street
uutiset.s: The message from Washington this week was unmistakable: America must do whatever it takes to win the artificial-intelligence race with China, and the government is prepared to intervene to make it happen.

uutiset.t: Traders Buy the Dip as Stocks Rise on Black Friday
uutiset.s: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Hong Kong Is Selling The City It Used To Be
uutiset.s: Hong Kong is turning nostalgia into a booming industry. From period crime dramas to film-set visitor attractions, locals are jumping at the chance to escape to the 1980s and 90s. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Black Friday 2026: Shoppers Try to Cut Back, Hunt for Deals
uutiset.s: Black Friday spending is projected to rise in 2026 as wary shoppers stock up early on essentials and lean into deals. Bloomberg’s Annie Bang reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Jump After Volatile First Week Since IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares climbed above their $83 initial public offering price as the artificial intelligence lab finished its first calendar week on the Nasdaq after its record-setting debut on a positive note.

uutiset.t: UK Steel Sector Says UK-EU Agreement Gives Rivals Unfair Edge
uutiset.s: Britain’s steel sector wants the government to reverse part of its recent deal with the European Union, which it says gives the bloc’s steel exporters an unfair advantage over their UK peers.

uutiset.t: Colombia Peso Stumbles as Mounting Risks Test Carry-Fueled Rally
uutiset.s: The Colombian peso is headed for its worst month in more than four years as a toxic mix of trouble at home and abroad takes the shine off one of the year’s most resilient currencies.

uutiset.t: Lula escolhe Trabuco para acalmar mercado
uutiset.s: Martha Beck fala da escolha de Lula por Trabuco para a Fazenda. Edição de Patricia Xavier. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Rains Ease El Niño Crop Fears in Brazil’s Top Soybean Region
uutiset.s: A sea of vigorous, leafy green plants deep inside Brazil’s top soybean region is easing fears that El Niño would bring crop losses to the world’s top producer.

uutiset.t: Power Outages, Flood Risks Linger as Storm Leaves East Coast
uutiset.s: More than 400,000 homes and businesses along the East Coast are without power after an explosive storm uprooted trees in Queens and Manhattan and inundated commuter rail lines in New Jersey on Thanksgiving Day.

uutiset.t: Altria’s Interest in Imperial May Affect Its AB InBev Stake
uutiset.s: A possible three-way deal to reshape the global tobacco industry may spill over into another business whose products are sometimes consumed alongside cigarettes — beer.

uutiset.t: US Stocks Rebound as Traders Pile Into Battered Tech Shares
uutiset.s: US stocks rallied Friday, capping a week of whiplash as dip buyers scooped up some beaten down technology shares despite lingering worries about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom.

uutiset.t: Emerging-Market Stocks Eye Best Week Since June on Tech Rebound
uutiset.s: Emerging-market stocks are heading for their biggest weekly gain since June as investors pile back into technology shares following a recent selloff, capping a volatile week across global markets.

uutiset.t: Copper Surges Most in Seven Months as Risk Appetite Returns
uutiset.s: Copper climbed the most since April, extending its rebound from an 11-month low earlier this week, as risk appetite returned after a rout fueled by concerns over the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Treasuries Drop as Stock Rise Saps Demand for Haven Bonds
uutiset.s: US Treasuries fell as the market reopened after the Thanksgiving holiday, with gains in equities damping demand for haven assets.
